preview.title: Panda Dock · Dev preview
preview.heroDesc: Below is the UI of each entry. After installing into Chrome, load the extension from the dist/ directory (chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked).
preview.popupTitle: Popup shown when clicking the toolbar icon
preview.sidePanelTitle: Toolbox page (shared by the native side panel and the in-page drawer)
preview.contentTitle: Floating ball and drawer injected into web pages
preview.contentNote: The real extension injects a draggable floating ball into every http(s) page: drag it to dock against the left or right edge of the screen; it half-hides when the mouse leaves and slides out fully on hover. Clicking the ball opens the toolbox drawer on the right side of the page by default (this is exactly what you see in the browser preview; in real Chrome you can switch to opening the native side panel in settings, and the side panel page can conversely open the drawer in the page). Click the floating ball at the middle right of the page to try it.
